name: qURL
description: Mint, resolve, audit, and rotate scope-limited expiring access links (qURLs) for AI agents. Without QURL_API_KEY it runs through the local qURL CLI (no account); with a key it uses the qURL API.

QURL_API_KEY.description: Optional. Without it, the tools run through the local qURL CLI (qurl), which needs no account. With it, the tools use the qURL API: a key with qurl:read, qurl:write, and/or qurl:resolve scopes from https://layerv.ai.

QURL_API_URL.description: qURL API base URL. Defaults to https://api.layerv.ai. Override only for testing against a non-production qURL backend.

QURL_MCP_FEEDBACK.description: Set to off to hide and disable outbound LayerV product feedback. Default on. Feedback is sent only by an explicit submit_feedback tool call.
